main_body: A round leaf-clump canopy filling the whole 16x16-tile area (about 48 rows tall). It has a few brown twig patches and no trunk or front face.
top_band: Mixed light, mid and dark greens run from row 0 to row 47 with no step. It reads as one flat foliage surface seen from above, not a separate top band.
evidence: A single column through the middle shows only leaf clumps, with the same greens repeating from top to bottom. There is no distinct top band, no front-edge line, no shaded or set-back south face, and no trunk or support below. The whole object is a plan-view blob of foliage with the front face missing, like the top-down slab in the guide.

style.evidence: The foliage has about 5 green steps, from a bright yellow-green highlight to a deep teal-green shadow. The clumps are built leaf by leaf with dithered variation. The outline is a dark green-teal tone next to the leaves, not neutral black. No area of 5x5 pixels or more is a flat fill. Tile density is comparable to the reference canopies, with many colours per tile. The brown twig patches add a bit of variety. The piece has no trunk, but this part judges shading craft, and the canopy matches the references on it.
